mapper.insert: INSERT INTO mcp_access_token (user_id, name, token_hash, token_prefix, creator_id, is_deleted, version) VALUES (#{userId}, #{name}, #{tokenHash}, #{tokenPrefix}, #{creatorId}, 0, 0)
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM mcp_access_token WHERE token_hash = #{tokenHash} AND is_deleted = 0 LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM mcp_access_token WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId} AND is_deleted = 0 LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM mcp_access_token WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY gmt_create DESC, id DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE mcp_access_token SET revoked_at = #{revokedAt}, modifier_id = #{modifierId}, version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId} AND revoked_at IS NULL AND is_deleted = 0
